title: Apple's 1987 Knowledge Navigator Video
summary: Apple's 1987 Knowledge Navigator concept video imagines a conversational voice assistant, multi-touch tablet and video calling used by a professor. It was made years before the graphical web existed.
why: HN cites it as an early vision of voice assistants and software agents, often when comparing it with Siri and modern AI.

quote.text: Here's an Apple video about conversational voice-based digital assistants... from 1987
